name: Yoshino Yuu
source:
Yuu is a new student who was transfered to Masahiro's class. She seems to be a wealthy daughter of a hospital director, and for some reason she pretends to know Masahiro.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050421021055fw_/http://home.att.ne.jp/blue/hironi/nirvana/natsusora.htm]Official Website[/url].]
